description: Checks UI and error strings against WCAG 3.3.1 (Error Identification), 3.3.3 (Error Suggestion), 4.1.3 (status messages that vanish) and plain-language convention. Pass `messages`: a list of strings, or objects `{ text, where, autoDismissMs }` where `where` is inline, toast, tooltip, placeholder and so on. Flags: says what went wrong but not what to do next, states a rule without an action, blames the person, is a code or generic phrase only, contains system jargon, is shouted, runs long, or disappears (toast, tooltip, placeholder, auto-dismiss under 20 seconds). For each message that needs work it returns a fill-in template (problem, then one step) chosen by the kind of error, with the slots named. It does not write the final copy. Judges wording by pattern; it cannot see whether a message is linked to its field or announced.

messages.description: Error and status strings, one per item.

where.description: inline, toast, tooltip, placeholder, banner, modal

name: error_message_check
title: Error message check
